replies.body:
Okay I looked the video more closely and I found some things.

At 0:02 you can see I miss many hits with the yellow guy, aimbot doesn't miss any hits from what I searched.

At 0:04 There you can see clearly a lag spike and inmediately I turn around because what I do when the game freezes is hit and move my mouse randomly to see if I can hit him.

Then I just kill him and move to the other guy and kill him when he was distracted with someone.

Then at 0:12 the red guy come I just hit him and Fast Hit Glitch comes up that's why he flew while I was hitting him.

About Kill Aura, This can't be hacks I always get close to the person I'm going to kill and about Aimbot, I miss many hits here.

I don't see any hacked client here...
